set.body: Human-annotated detector benchmark and reports; separate from existing synthetic/pinned-detector conformance. First gate: admit named redistributable or fetch-reproducible recordings with dataset version/license/hash, annotation ontology, annotator agreement where available, and an explicit coverage matrix spanning static images, reading, video, pursuit, noise, blink/loss/dropout and sampling degradation. Missing labels/coverage remain visible. Freeze event matching (including boundary tolerance and one-to-one matching), parameter tuning versus evaluation splits, per-class/stimulus aggregation and unavailable-metric handling before evaluating. Report precision/recall/F1, onset/offset error, duration/count bias, centre and peak-velocity error where reference labels support them, and robustness curves. Machine-readable artifacts carry dataset identity, detector/configuration, platform and source revision. Deterministic smoke and non-vacuous failure fixtures verify scoring. Completion of this report task means a reproducible coverage-explicit benchmark, not automatic detector qualification; any scientific pass thresholds must be declared separately before evaluating and never inferred from aggregate accuracy.
